narrative: A new Chinese open-weight, frontier-class coding model is precisely the supply-side momentum the share-floor thesis needs: MiniMax M3 claims 59.0% on SWE-Bench Pro - ahead of GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro - with a 1M-token context and native multimodality. More credible open-weight contenders is the precondition that feeds the cohort's routable share, even before traffic materializes.
remaining_gap: Scores are company-reported; weights and report are promised within ~10 days but unshipped, so M3 is not yet routable or adding measurable OpenRouter share.
